hypothesis: CFO-grade, demonstrable ROI math and original diagrams will generate more qualified watch time and subscriber conversion than model-announcement Shorts.
audience: Founders, CFOs, operators, procurement and transformation leaders evaluating AI pilots
hook: The AI assistant saved 60 hours. Which expense disappeared?
titleVariants: Your AI Pilot Saved 67 Hours. Did It Save Any Money?
How to Measure AI ROI in 30 Days: A CFO-Ready Scorecard
The AI ROI Calculation Most Teams Get Wrong
CTA: PrismBay AI helps founders, operators, and executives implement practical AI business systems.
publishTimeReason: Select only after production QA and confirmed publishing route. Metricool best-time signal currently favors ~16:00 America/Guyana midweek; not a promise of results.

successThresholds.note: Provisional because video-level long-form baseline is not yet available. Recalibrate once Studio data exists.
successThresholds.primary: At 7 days, 50+ qualified long-form views and >=35% average percentage viewed, with no misleading financial claims.
successThresholds.secondary: At least 1 net new subscriber attributable to the video by 7 days, where attribution is available.
successThresholds.safeguard: No confirmed policy incident, false ROI arithmetic, or unsafe automation instruction.

portfolioDecisionRules.SCALE: Both primary thresholds achieved, positive subscriber signal, and safe execution; create adjacent CFO workflow example.
portfolioDecisionRules.RETEST: Impressions present but title-thumbnail CTR weak relative to the channel long-form baseline; test alternative packaging.
portfolioDecisionRules.MODIFY: Retention falls sharply during setup or math scenes; shorten exposition and improve chart pacing.
portfolioDecisionRules.STOP: Poor audience response after meaningful impressions, or material policy/quality concerns.

provenance: Original hypothetical arithmetic; NIST/OECD cited for governance context only.
